expect.bodytext:
The day slips quietly out of its coat
and hangs gold light on the edge of evening.
Somewhere, a window hums with laughter,
somewhere else, a kettle forgets to sing.

I walk between moments that almost matter—
a breeze, a glance, a name I nearly recall—
and wonder how the smallest seconds
are the ones that hold us all.

Night doesn’t fall; it gathers,
soft as a thought you didn’t mean to keep.
And in its dark, the world remembers
every promise it made in sleep.
